## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix "Resolve the candidate path before the home containment check" before merge: `preview` returns the contents of files outside the home directory for a relative path containing `..`. The added outside-path test uses only an absolute path, so it does not detect this.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview(home, relative)`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file(home)`, which returns the `settings.toml` path, with tests for both. It also adds `tests/review-note.txt`, a one-line text file that no test references.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve the candidate path before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` returns the first 200 characters of a file outside `home` instead of raising `ValueError("outside home")`. `candidate.is_relative_to(Path(home))` compares path segments lexically, so `home/../secret.txt` passes; a symlink under `home` that points outside passes the same way. — Any caller that passes user-supplied relative paths exposes the start of every file the process can read. — Fix: Compare `candidate.resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()` and read the resolved path, then extend `test_preview` at `tests/test_paths.py:20` with a `..` case.

(none)

## Suggestions
- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Separate decode failures from the outside-home ValueError — `preview(home, "photo.png")` under a UTF-8 locale raises `UnicodeDecodeError` from `candidate.read_text()`. That exception is a `ValueError` subclass, so `except ValueError` cannot tell it from `ValueError("outside home")` raised at line 13. — A caller that catches `ValueError` to report an outside-home path also reports undecodable files under home as outside home. — Fix: Raise a dedicated exception type for the outside-home rejection, or catch `UnicodeDecodeError` in `preview` and raise a distinct error.
